prompt: Trong mặt phẳng tọa độ <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>O</mi><mi>x</mi><mi>y</mi></mrow></semantics></math>, cho <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>A</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>;</mo><mn>1</mn><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow></mrow></semantics></math>; <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>B</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>;</mo><mn>2</mn><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow></mrow></semantics></math>; <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>C</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>;</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>4</mn><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow></mrow></semantics></math>. Có bao nhiêu điểm <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mi>D</mi></semantics></math> để <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mi>A</mi></semantics></math>, <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mi>B</mi></semantics></math>, <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mi>C</mi></semantics></math>, <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mi>D</mi></semantics></math> là bốn đỉnh của một hình bình hành?
solution:
Tứ giác <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>A</mi><mi>B</mi><mi>C</mi><mi>D</mi></mrow></semantics></math> là hình bình hành khi và chỉ khi <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mover><mrow><mi>A</mi><mi>B</mi></mrow><mo accent="true">→</mo></mover><mo>=</mo><mover><mrow><mi>D</mi><mi>C</mi></mrow><mo accent="true">→</mo></mover></mrow></semantics></math>.
		Do đó tồn tại duy nhất 1 điểm <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mi>D</mi></semantics></math> thõa mãn.
